messages:
Priya (DevEx): Heads up — got a bug report: sample app in a pnpm monorepo fails at edge deploy (Cloudflare Workers adapter). Customer sees "Package subpath './dist/esm/index.mjs' is not exported by package.json" only when using workspace symlinks.
Liam (SDK): Can you share the package.json of the SDK?
Priya (DevEx): Exports look like: { "main": "./dist/cjs/index.js", "module": "./dist/esm/index.mjs", "exports": {".": {"import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs","require":"./dist/cjs/index.js"}} } — but the worker bundler seems to follow the symlink root and then fail the subpath check.
Nora (Build): Cloudflare's bundler (wrangler/vite-plugin-workers) resolves packages inside the monorepo differently than a flat node_modules. pnpm symlinks to the package folder and a bundler that walks the symlink target will run into exports enforcement.
Priya (DevEx): Locally `pnpm dev` + adapter works though, only CI deploy fails.
Liam (SDK): Two quick things: 1) include a flat compatibility entry at package root (e.g. ./dist/index.mjs + ./dist/index.cjs) and add an exports fallback for that path; 2) ensure we ship types at root with "types": "./dist/index.d.ts" so TS users in workspaces don't get missing types.
Nora (Build): Alternative: update the sample app's build to bundle the SDK into the edge artifact (mark it not external). Wrapping the SDK in the app's esbuild/vite config fixed this for one customer. Not ideal for caching/size though.
Priya (DevEx): Would adding a test in CI that performs a pnpm workspace install and runs a Cloudflare build catch regressions?
Liam (SDK): Yes — add a smoke test job: create a temp pnpm workspace, add SDK as workspace dependency (symlinked), run the adapter build, and assert the artifact contains the expected export entry. I'll add that + a compatibility artifact generation step to the publish pipeline.
Nora (Build): I can add a note in the sample app README with troubleshooting steps: "If you see exports subpath errors during edge deploy: 1) try building with bundling enabled, 2) try `pnpm install --shamefully-hoist` to emulate flattened installs, or 3) use the compatibility bundle (vX.Y.Z-beta)".
Priya (DevEx): Nice. Also callout for maintainers: avoid runtime use of `require.resolve` or `fs`-based path discovery in published bundles — edge runtimes and ESM builds blow up.
Liam (SDK): We'll also add a small diagnostic script to `scripts/check-exports.js` that runs during prepublish to detect any exported paths pointing at nested folders that might fail under symlink resolution.
E2E-bot: Action created: INF-2452 "pnpm workspace edge export repro + compatibility artifact" assigned to @Liam and @Nora.
Priya (DevEx): Thanks — I'll push a tiny repro repo to examples/edge/pnpm-symlink-repro and link it from onboarding docs. Closing thread once CI + sample updated. :+1:
